tips_en: Read MoLT first: it presents the most foundational contribution and the strongest scaling evidence, showing how recurrent-depth Transformers can reuse KV memory while improving accuracy and token efficiency. Read I2VT next if you are interested in generative video editing, as it transfers image-editing expertise into video models without paired video data. Real2SimLab complements both by standardizing evaluation and preventing dataset contamination, although it currently offers infrastructure rather than systematic model comparisons.
tips_zh: 建议先读 MoLT：它提出了最基础且证据最充分的架构贡献，展示了循环深度 Transformer 如何复用 KV 记忆，同时提升准确率和 token 效率。若关注生成式视频编辑，可接着读 I2VT，它在无需成对视频数据的情况下将图像编辑能力迁移到视频模型。Real2SimLab 则从评测层面补充这两项工作，强调统一接口与数据去污染，但目前尚缺少系统性的模型对比。
